dataset.v: 使用 GE C-arm Medical System 扫描 silicon aortic phantom，生成 512×512×510 CT 图像作为 ground truth
dataset.excerpt: We collect a phantom dataset by scanning a silicon aortic phantom with GE C-arm Medical System.

acquisition.v: human organ 与 phantom 实验均使用 50 projections；phantom 系统共采集 582 projections
acquisition.excerpt: We only use 50 projections for experiments.

acquisition.v: human organ 数据在 180° 范围内；phantom 数据 position primary angle 从 -103° 到 93°，position secondary angle 为 0°
acquisition.excerpt: with position primary angle from -103°to 93°and position secondary angle of 0°.

acquisition.v: human organ 投影加入 3% noise
acquisition.excerpt: we capture 50 projections with 3% noise in the range of 180°.

acquisition.v: human organ 投影由 TIGRE [5] 生成
acquisition.excerpt: we generate projections by a tomographic toolbox TIGRE [5].

acquisition.k: sparse-view / low-mAs / spatial modulation 区分
acquisition.v: 论文聚焦 sparse-view CBCT reconstruction，通过减少 projection views 降低剂量；未涉及 low-mAs 或 spatial modulation
acquisition.excerpt: This paper focuses on the latter, i.e., sparse-view CBCT reconstruction.

training.excerpt: We use Adam optimizer with a learning rate that starts at 1 ×10−3 and steps down to 1 ×10−4.
We use Adam optimizer with a learning rate that starts at 1 ×10−3 and steps down to 1 ×10−4.
The batch size is 2048 rays at each iteration.

training.v: 取决于 CT 数据大小；例如 128×128×128 chest CT 每条 ray 采样 192 点
training.excerpt: For example, we sample 192 points along each ray for the 128×128×128 chest CT.
All experiments are conducted on a single RTX 3090 GPU.
We use the same hyper-parameter setting for hash encoder as [14].

training.v: 4 层全连接；前三层 32-channel 宽，ReLU 激活；最后一层 1 个神经元接 sigmoid；第二层激活处有 skip connection
training.excerpt: the network is composed of 4 fully-connected layers. The first three layers are 32-channel wide and have ReLU activation functions in between, while the last layer has one neuron followed by a sigmoid activation.
hash encoder produces much smaller outputs (32 in our setting)

loss.v: real 与 synthesized projections 之间的 L2 loss
loss.excerpt: NAF is updated by minimizing the L2 loss between real and synthesized projections.

loss.v: L(Θ,Φ) = Σ_{r∈B} ||Ir(r) − Is(r)||²，B 为 ray batch

baselines.excerpt: FDK [7] is firstly chosen as a representative of analytical methods.
The second method SART[2] is a robust iterative reconstruction algorithm.

baselines.v: iterative method with a total-variation regularizer，引用 [20]
baselines.excerpt: ASD-POCS[20] is another iterative method with a total-variation regularizer.

baselines.v: CBCT variant of IntraTomo [28]，作为 frequency-encoding deep learning 方法
baselines.excerpt: We implement a CBCT variant of IntraTomo [28], named IntraTomo3D, as an example of frequency-encoding deep learning methods.

metrics.v: peak signal-to-noise ratio (PNSR)，单位 dB，统计评估 artifact suppression 性能
metrics.excerpt: We evaluate five methods quantitatively in terms of peak signal-to-noise ratio (PNSR) and structural similarity (SSIM) [25].

metrics.v: structural similarity，衡量两个信号的 perceptual difference
metrics.excerpt: while SSIM measures the perceptual difference between two signals.

metrics.v: PSNR/SSIM 越高表示重建越准确
metrics.excerpt: Higher PNSR/SSIM values represent the accurate reconstruction and vice versa.

metrics.v: 在 abdomen 数据集上比较 iterative 与 learning-based 方法的逐 slice 性能
metrics.excerpt: Fig.3: Slice-wise performance of iterative and learning-based methods on the abdomen dataset.

metrics.k: 不同 views 数量评估
metrics.v: 在 abdomen 数据集上比较不同输入 views 数量下的性能
metrics.excerpt: Fig.4: Performance under different number of views on the abdomen dataset.

results.v: 五个数据集上五种方法的 PSNR/SSIM 见 Table 2
results.excerpt: Performance Our method produces quantitatively best results in both human organ and phantom datasets as listed in Table 2.

results.v: NAF 在 abdomen 数据集上 PSNR 比第二好的 SART 高 3.07 dB
results.excerpt: For example, the PSNR value of our method in the abdomen dataset is 3.07 dB higher than that of the second-best method SART.

results.v: NAF 可在 10-40 分钟内重建详细 CT 模型，与 iterative methods 相当
results.excerpt: method can reconstruct a detailed CT model within 10-40 minutes, which is comparable to iterative methods.

results.v: NAF 运行时间与 iterative methods 相似，比 frequency-encoding 深度学习方法 IntraTomo3D 快 3 倍
results.excerpt: NAF spends similar running time to iterative methods and is 3×faster than the frequency-encoding deep learning method IntraTomo3D.
